extracted.name: Blueberry Banana Bread
extracted.description: I hadn’t been able to find an easy blueberry banana bread recipe, so I made it myself!
instruction_lines: Melt the butter in a small bowl and pour melted butter into a larger mixing bowl
Add bananas to the mixing bowl and mash with a fork
Add the rest of the wet ingredients and mix
Once mixed, add in the dry ingredients and mix
Pre-heat oven to 350 and butter a bread pan
Pour mix into the bread pan and pop into the oven for 45-55 minutes
Test if cooked with a toothpick
